fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Transient (Seebeck + Joule + Fourier, 2-node thermal ODE)
source: Rowe, D.M. (Ed.) (2006). CRC Handbook of Thermoelectrics; Goldsmid, H.J. (2010). Introduction to Thermoelectricity, Springer; Riffat & Ma (2003) Appl. Thermal Eng. 23, 913-935.

unit.name: Generic Bi2Te3 TEC stack — 4 modules in series, ~80 W cooling each (reused from F1a)

n_modules.note: Modules electrically in series; share the same current I

alpha_module.note: Effective Seebeck coefficient per module (~127 Bi2Te3 thermocouples). Rowe Handbook Ch.1

ZT_ref.note: Intrinsic material figure of merit for commercial Bi2Te3 at 300K (Rowe 2006). The lumped device ZT=alpha^2/(R*K)*T~0.37 is lower because R,K include lead/contact losses. Diagnostic only.

C_cold.note: Lumped heat capacity of cold-plate node + attached cold-side heat sink mass

C_hot.note: Lumped heat capacity of hot-plate node + hot-side heat sink mass

T_load.note: Cold-side thermal load setpoint / chamber temperature

Q_load.note: External heat load applied to cold side
